operations.command: cd /etc/nixos && NIX_CONFIG='experimental-features = nix-command flakes' nix-shell shell.nix --run 'make build' >/tmp/nixosctl-build.log 2>&1 && printf built || { tail -40 /tmp/nixosctl-build.log; exit 1; }

cd /etc/nixos && printf 'n\n' | NIX_CONFIG='experimental-features = nix-command flakes' ./build/nixosctl install --format --yes >/tmp/nixosctl-install.log 2>&1 && printf installed || { tail -60 /tmp/nixosctl-install.log; exit 1; }

set -e; test -f /mnt/etc/nixos/flake.nix; listing=$(btrfs subvolume list -a /mnt); for volume in @root @home; do echo "$listing" | grep -qE "@snapshots/$volume/CLEAN$" || { echo "no published CLEAN for $volume"; exit 1; }; [ "$(btrfs property get -ts "/mnt/.snapshots/$volume/CLEAN" ro 2>/dev/null)" = 'ro=true' ] || { echo "CLEAN for $volume is not read-only"; exit 1; }; done; if echo "$listing" | grep -qF 'CLEAN.tmp.'; then echo 'a CLEAN temporary was left behind'; exit 1; fi; printf clean-snapshots
set -e; findmnt -rn --target /etc/nixos | grep -F '@persist/dirs/etc!nixos' >/dev/null; test -f /etc/nixos/flake.nix; printf persisted-config

set -e; timeout 420 systemctl is-system-running --wait >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; state=$(systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || true); failed=$(systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain | awk '{print $1}' | tr '\n' ' '); refused=$(journalctl -b -o cat 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'Service has no ExecStart' || true); echo "state=$state failed=$failed refused=$refused"; journalctl -b -o cat 2>/dev/null | grep 'Service has no ExecStart' || true; [ "$state" = running ] || exit 1; [ -z "$failed" ] || exit 1; [ "$refused" -eq 0 ] || exit 1; printf system-healthy
